defensives.name: Divine Shield
defensives.usage_rule: Use it to become immune to all damage when you would otherwise die, accepting that it blocks healing on you afterward.

defensives.name: Blessing of Protection
defensives.usage_rule: Cast it on yourself or an ally about to take fatal physical damage; it blocks the damage but also forbids healing them.

defensives.name: Blessing of Sacrifice
defensives.usage_rule: Cast it on a tank or ally under heavy damage to transfer a share of their damage taken to yourself.

defensives.name: Divine Protection
defensives.usage_rule: Use it during a heavy incoming damage window to reduce what you take while you keep fighting.

defensives.name: Lay on Hands
defensives.usage_rule: Use it as a full-health emergency heal on yourself or an ally about to die when nothing else will save them.
